description: This file defines the GoalModel class, which represents a savings goal with properties such as id, name, target amount, and current amount. It includes a computed property for progress and a copyWith method for immutability.

classes.name: GoalModel
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a savings goal with properties for id, name, target amount, current amount, calculated progress, and a method to create modified copies.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new instance of GoalModel, replacing specified fields with new values while keeping others unchanged.
